{{Otheruses|Milk Run}}
{{Quote|This should be a total blue milk run, kid. But it'll give you a chance to pick up some negotiating skills. Let's head to Tatooine.|[[Kyle Katarn]] to [[Jaden Korr]] about the [[Mission to Tatooine (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|Mission to Tatooine]]|audio=JediAcademy-BlueMilkRun.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
"'''Blue milk run'''" was a slang term used by military personnel to describe a simple and easy mission. The term was particularly common amongst [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as a reference to the simplicity of obtaining a bottle of the popular [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]]. For example, during the [[Battle of Rendili]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] commented that his investigation of an exploration vessel would likely be "nothing more than a blue milk run." Missions described as blue milk runs had an unfortunate tendency to be more difficult than initially thought. Regardless, [[Kyle Katarn]] liked to use this phrase.
